HotelProfile.title: HotelProfile
HotelProfile.description: Configuration profile for the hotel managed by the signed-in user.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching the path {userId}.

hotelName.description: Display name of the hotel included on exported PDF and Excel reports.

hotelLocation.description: City or island location of the hotel.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

HotelReview.title: HotelReview
HotelReview.description: Individual hotel guest review analyzed by AI for sentiment, complaint triage, and suggested guest response.

guestName.description: Guest display name or booking alias.

language.description: Detected or selected language of the review.

rating.description: Guest score on a 1.0 to 10.0 scale.

stayDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the stay/review date used for report filtering.

reviewText.description: Full text of the guest review.

sentimentScore.description: Normalized sentiment confidence/positivity score from 0 to 100.

departments.description: Bounded list (max 6) of hotel department category codes mentioned in the review.

keyHighlights.description: Bounded list (max 8) of short key takeaways or complaint points.

summaryLine.description: Concise one-line AI summary of the review.

suggestedReply.description: AI-generated polite response to the guest in the review's language.

resolved.description: Whether the hotel team has addressed or replied to this review.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/reviews/{reviewId}.description: User-scoped subcollection of analyzed hotel reviews.
